exposure: History of complications during pregnancy or labor
history of complications during pregnancy or labor
cohort: 1470 women who underwent Cesarean section deliveries at a single tertiary center
finding: A relatively small proportion of women following Cesarean section were prescribed oral iron at discharge, and factors associated with prescription included earlier gestational age at birth, history of complications during pregnancy or labor, higher blood loss, post-partum anemia, blood transfusion, and antenatal iron supplementation.
